DISCOVERY_PREDICT0.label: Predict Baseline Sales Units
DISCOVERY_PREDICT0.description: Predicts the number of baseline sales units and maps fields from the predicted data to the recipe.

TRANSFORM0.label: Forecast Sales Units
TRANSFORM0.description: Forecasts the number of sales units, sets the value to 0 for the rows without any forecasted sales units, and calculates the next forecast date.

TRANSFORM1.label: Edit Predicted Baseline Sales Attribute
TRANSFORM1.description: Changes the label and API name of the attribute storing the predicted baseline sales units.

FILTER0.label: Filter Forecast Sales
FILTER0.description: Filters rows containing forecast sales units.

FILTER1.label: Filter Historical Sales Weeks with No Sales
FILTER1.description: Filters the weeks in the historical sales data without any sales.

OUTPUT0.label: Forecasted Baseline Sales Units Dataset
OUTPUT0.description: Writes the forecasted baseline sales units to the Forecasted Baseline Sales Units Dataset.

FILTER4.label: Filter Products with Promotion Values
FILTER4.description: Filters rows containing a promotion value that’s greater than 0.

FILTER5.label: Filter Rows without Promotion Values
FILTER5.description: Filters rows with a promotion value of 0.

TRANSFORM6.label: Edit Attribute
TRANSFORM6.description: Changes the label and API name of the attribute storing the predicted sales units for products without promotions and drops columns that aren’t required.

OUTPUT4.label: Non-Promotional Example Dataset
OUTPUT4.description: Writes the non-promotional example dataset to the Non-Promotional Example Dataset dataset.

TRANSFORM7.label: Calculate Uplift Volume
TRANSFORM7.description: Calculates the uplift volume and other uplift details for products in the weeks when promotion is run.

OUTPUT5.label: Promotional Example Dataset
OUTPUT5.description: Writes to the dataset of the Promotional Example Dataset.

JOIN0.label: Join Edited Attribute Using Account and Product IDs
JOIN0.description: Joins forecasted sales units with the matching edited attribute rows based on accounts and product IDs.

JOIN1.label: Join Uplift Details Using Accounts, Product IDs, and Partition Keys
JOIN1.description: Joins forecasted sales units with matching uplift details based on accounts, product IDs, and partition keys.

JOIN2.label: Join Non-Promotional Sales Volume
JOIN2.description: Join the rows containing non-promotional sales volume.

JOIN3.label: Join Forecasted Sales Units
JOIN3.description: Joins rows containing the forecast dates that are on or after the current date and on or before the next forecast week dates with matching forecasted sales units based on forecast dates, accounts, and product IDs.

TRANSFORM8.label: Identify Required Forecasted Sales Units
TRANSFORM8.description: Identifies required forecasted sales units based on currently available values and drops columns that aren’t required. It changes the labels and API names of attributes storing forecasted baseline sales volume details.

TRANSFORM9.label: Compute Account ID
TRANSFORM9.description: Generates a unique Account ID corresponding to the predefined Account ID for further extraction in the TPE.

TRANSFORM10.label: Edit Attributes
TRANSFORM10.description: Changes the label and API name of the attribute storing the non-promotional sales volume.

OUTPUT6.label: Required Forecasted Sales Units Dataset
OUTPUT6.description: Writes the required forecasted sales units to the Required Forecasted Sales Units Dataset.

TRANSFORM11.label: Edit Attributes
TRANSFORM11.description: Changes the label and API name of the attribute storing the forecasted sales units with non-promotional sales units.

APPEND1.label: Append Past Sales Data and No Sales Weeks From Forecast
APPEND1.description: Appends rows containing past sales data with rows representing weeks with no sales.

APPEND2.label: Append Forecast Sales Units
APPEND2.description: Appends rows containing forecast sales units with the past sales units.

TRANSFORM12.label: Identify Weekly Sales Records
TRANSFORM12.description: Identify rows containing weekly sales records.

TRANSFORM14.label: Identify Rows with Required Forecast Duration
TRANSFORM14.description: Identifies rows with forecast dates that are on or after the current date, and on or before the next week forecast date. It also sets the forecasted value to 0 for rows with dates for which you don’t want the forecast.

LOAD_DATASET8.label: Required Forecasted Sales Units Dataset
LOAD_DATASET8.description: Contains the forecasted sales units for the duration after the number of weeks selected for this use case in Scoring Framework.

LOAD_DATASET9.label: Promotional and Non-Promotional Feature Dataset
LOAD_DATASET9.description: Contains the promotional and non-promotional feature dataset.

FILTER7.label: Filter Required Forecasted Sales Units
FILTER7.description: Filters the forecasted sales units for the duration after the number of weeks selected for this use case in Scoring Framework.
